arxiv-2111-07826.title: The Interplay of Regularizing Factors in the Model of Upper Hybrid Oscillations of Cold Plasma
arxiv-2111-07826.creator: Maria I. Delova, Olga S. Rozanova*
arxiv-2111-07826.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Maria I. Delova, Olga S. Rozanova*. A one-dimensional nonlinear model of the so-called upper hybrid oscillations in a magnetoactive plasma is investigated taking into account electron-ion collisions. It is known that both the presence of an external magnetic field of strength B 0 B_{0} and a sufficiently large collisional factor ν \nu help suppress the formation of a finite-dimensional singularity in a solution (breaking of oscillations).

arxiv-2312-11662.title: Layer Hall counterflow as a model probe of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene
arxiv-2312-11662.creator: Jihang Zhu, Dawei Zhai, Cong Xiao, Wang Yao
arxiv-2312-11662.description: Abstract The recent constructions of flat moiré minibands in specifically twisted multilayer graphene and twisted transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) have facilitated the observation of strong correlations with a convenient tunability. These correlations in flat bands result in the band dispersion heavily influenced by carrier densities, leading to filling-dependent quasiparticle band renormalizations.

arxiv-2401-15355.title: Improved bounds on the interactive capacity via error pattern analysis
arxiv-2401-15355.creator: Mudit Aggarwal †, Manuj Mukherjee ‡
arxiv-2401-15355.description: Abstract Any interactive protocol between a pair of parties can be reliably simulated in the presence of noise with a multiplicative overhead on the number of rounds (Schulman 1996). The reciprocal of the best (least) overhead is called the interactive capacity of the noisy channel.

arxiv-2402-12322.title: Simultaneous reweighting of Transverse Momentum Dependent distributions Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2402-12322.creator: M. Boglione, U. D’Alesio, C. Flore, J. O. Gonzalez-Hernandez, F. Murgia, A. Prokudin
arxiv-2402-12322.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by M. Boglione, U. D’Alesio, C. Flore, J. O. Gonzalez-Hernandez, F. Murgia, A. Prokudin. The Bayesian reweighting procedure is extended to the case of multiple independent extractions of transverse momentum dependent parton distributions (TMDs). By exploiting the data on transverse single spin asymmetries, A N A_{N} , for inclusive pion production in polarized proton-proton collisions measured at RHIC, we perform a simultaneous reweighting of the quark Sivers, transversity and Collins TMD functions extracted from semi-inclusive deep inelastic scattering (SIDIS) and e + ​ e −

arxiv-2403-12662.title: Generic non-uniqueness of minimizing harmonic maps from a ball to a sphere
arxiv-2403-12662.creator: Antoine Detaille, Katarzyna Mazowiecka
arxiv-2403-12662.description: Abstract . In this note, we study non-uniqueness for minimizing harmonic maps from B 3 B^{3} to 𝕊 2 {\mathbb{S}}^{2} . We show that every boundary map can be modified to a boundary map that admits multiple minimizers of the Dirichlet energy by a small W 1 , p W^{1,p} -change for p < 2 p<2 .

arxiv-2503-24046.title: Contrasting exchange-field and spin-transfer torque driving mechanisms in all-electric electron spin resonance
arxiv-2503-24046.creator: Jose Reina-Gálvez, Matyas Nachtigall, Nicolás Lorente, Jan Martinek, Christoph Wolf
arxiv-2503-24046.description: Abstract Understanding the coherent properties of electron spins driven by electric fields is crucial for their potential application in quantum-coherent nanoscience. In this work, we address two distinct driving mechanisms in electric-field driven electron-spin resonance as implemented in scanning tunneling spectroscopy.

arxiv-2509-17622.title: Overview of PlantCLEF 2023: Image-based Plant Identification at Global Scale
arxiv-2509-17622.creator: Hervé Goëau, Pierre Bonnet, Alexis Joly
arxiv-2509-17622.description: Abstract The world is estimated to be home to over 300,000 species of vascular plants. In the face of the ongoing biodiversity crisis, expanding our understanding of these species is crucial for the advancement of human civilization, encompassing areas such as agriculture, construction, and pharmacopoeia.

arxiv-2511-17724.title: AngioDG: Interpretable Channel-informed Feature-modulated Single-source Domain Generalization for Coronary Vessel Segmentation in X-ray Angiography
arxiv-2511-17724.creator: Mohammad Atwany, Mojtaba Lashgari, Robin P. Choudhury, Vicente Grau, Abhirup Banerjee
arxiv-2511-17724.description: Abstract Cardiovascular diseases are the leading cause of death globally, with X-ray Coronary Angiography (XCA) as the gold standard during real-time cardiac interventions. Segmentation of coronary vessels from XCA can facilitate downstream quantitative assessments, such as measurement of the stenosis severity and enhancing clinical decision-making.

arxiv-2512-01733.title: Answering Constraint Path Queries over Graphs
arxiv-2512-01733.creator: Heyang Li, Anthony Widjaja Lin, Domagoj Vrgoč
arxiv-2512-01733.description: Abstract . Constraints are powerful declarative constructs that allow users to conveniently restrict variable values that potentially range over an infinite domain. In this paper, we propose a constraint path query language over property graphs, which extends Regular Path Queries (RPQs) with SMT constraints on data attributes in the form of equality constraints and Linear Real Arithmetic (LRA) constraints.

arxiv-2601-06977.title: Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers for nonlinear constrained convex problems and applications to distributed resource allocation and constrained machine learning
arxiv-2601-06977.creator: Zhengjie Xiong, Yangyang Xu ∗
arxiv-2601-06977.description: Abstract We study a class of structured convex optimization problems, which have a two-block separable objective and nonlinear functional constraints as well as affine constraints that couple the two block variables. Such problems naturally arise from distributed resource allocation and constrained machine learning.

europmc-pmc6753140.title: DNA methylation loss promotes immune evasion of tumours with high mutation and copy number load.
europmc-pmc6753140.creator: Jung H, Kim HS, Kim JY, Sun JM, Ahn JS, Ahn MJ, Park K, Esteller M, Lee SH, Choi JK.
europmc-pmc6753140.description: Mitotic cell division increases tumour mutation burden and copy number load, predictive markers of the clinical benefit of immunotherapy. Cell division correlates also with genomic demethylation involving methylation loss in late-replicating partial methylation domains. Here we...

pmc-10696119.title: Does video e-learning improve pharmacy teams' attitudes and preparedness towards suicide prevention?
pmc-10696119.creator: Hayley C. Gorton, Hayley J. Berry, Claire L. O'Reilly, David Gardner, Andrea L. Murphy
pmc-10696119.description: BackgroundEvidence on the role of pharmacy teams in suicide prevention is growing. To support pharmacy teams, a video e-learning was produced by the Centre for Pharmacy Postgraduate Education (CPPE) involving an ‘on-the-sofa’ style group interview with people with personal and professional experience of suicide and suicide research.

pmc-10743543.title: Serum Metabolomic Profiling of Patients with Lipedema
pmc-10743543.creator: Sally Kempa, Christa Buechler, Bandik Föh, Oliver Felthaus, Lukas Prantl, Ulrich L Günther, Martina Müller, Stefanie Derer-Petersen, Christian Sina, Franziska Schmelter, Hauke C Tews, Erika Cione, Roberto Cannataro, Sandro Michelini
pmc-10743543.description: Lipedema is a chronic condition characterized by disproportionate and symmetrical enlargement of adipose tissue, predominantly affecting the lower limbs of women. This study investigated the use of metabolomics in lipedema research, with the objective of identifying complex metabolic disturbances and potential biomarkers for early detection, prognosis, and treatment strategies. The study group (n = 25) comprised women diagnosed with lipedema.

pmc-11380774.title: Familial adenomatous polyposis: a case report
pmc-11380774.creator: Endeshaw Asaye Kindie, Tigist Desta Beyera, Ephrem Tafesse Teferi, Daniel Zemenfes Ashebir, Henok Bahru Wodajeneh
pmc-11380774.description: BackgroundFamilial adenomatous polyposis is characterized by the presence of multiple colorectal adenomatous polyps and caused by germline mutations in the tumor suppressor gene and adenomatous polyposis coli, located on chromosome 5q21–q22. Familial adenomatous polyposis occurs in approximately 1/10,000 to 1/30,000 live births, and accounts for less than 1% of all colorectal cancers in the USA.

pmc-11458864.title: Tailoring silk-based covering material with matched mechanical properties for vascular tissue engineering
pmc-11458864.creator: Yangxiao Yu, Guangzhou Song, Mengnan Dai, Peixuan Li, Jianmei Xu, Yin Yin, Jiannan Wang
pmc-11458864.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Vascular covered stents play a significant therapeutic role in cardiovascular diseases. However, the poor compliance and biological inertness of commercial materials cause post-implantation complications. Silk fibroin (SF), as a biomaterial, possesses satisfactory hemocompatibility and tissue compatibility. In this study, we developed a silk film for use in covered stents by employing a layer-by-layer self-assembly strategy with regenerated SF on silk braiding fabric.

pmc-11492509.title: PS1/gamma-secretase acts as rogue chaperone of glutamate transporter EAAT2/GLT-1 in Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-11492509.creator: Florian Perrin, Lauren C. Anderson, Shane P. C. Mitchell, Priyanka Sinha, Yuliia Turchyna, Masato Maesako, Mei C. Q. Houser, Can Zhang, Steven L. Wagner, Rudolph E. Tanzi, Oksana Berezovska
pmc-11492509.description: The recently discovered interaction between presenilin 1 (PS1), a subunit of γ-secretase involved in amyloid-β (Aβ) peptide production, and GLT-1, the major brain glutamate transporter (EAAT2 in the human), may link two pathological aspects of Alzheimer’s disease: abnormal Aβ occurrence and neuronal network hyperactivity.

pmc-11496686.title: Phylogenetic analysis of selected species of Asteraceae on the basis of RPS 11 Gene
pmc-11496686.creator: Syeda Anber Zahra, Javed Iqbal, Banzeer Ahsan Abbasi, Sobia Kanwal, Mona S. Alwahibi, Mohamed S. Elshikh, Muhammad Rizwan, Rashid Iqbal, Tariq Mahmood
pmc-11496686.description: The Asteraceae family is a prominent group of flowering plants found across the globe, with the exception of Antarctica. The Asteraceae family is a largest flowering family pivotal group in plant evolution and diversification. Despite its importance, the genetic diversity within this family remains understudied.

pmc-12565756.title: Immunogenicity and Breakthrough Outcomes of mRNA Booster Strategies Among Healthcare Workers During the BA.1/BA.2 Omicron Surge
pmc-12565756.creator: Song Mi Moon, Jung Nam An, Jae Hyun Kwon, Sung Gyun Kim, Han Wool Kim
pmc-12565756.description: Throughout the 2019 coronavirus disease pandemic, various vaccine regimens were implemented. Real-world data comparing their effectiveness during the BA.1/BA.2 Omicron wave remain limited. We prospectively enrolled healthcare workers who had completed two doses of mRNA or ChAdOx1 (A) vaccine and received an mRNA vaccine booster (BNT162b2 (P) or mRNA-1273 (M)).

pmc-12566847.title: Development of Clinical-Grade Durvalumab-680LT and Nivolumab-800CW for Multispectral Fluorescent Imaging of the PD-1/PD-L1 Axis of the Immune Checkpoint Pathway
pmc-12566847.creator: Henrik K Huizinga, Wouter T R Hooghiemstra, Matthijs D Linssen, Derk P Allersma, Bahez Gareb, Bart G J Dekkers, Wouter B Nagengast, Marjolijn N Lub-de Hooge, Giorgio Cozza
pmc-12566847.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) are effective against various advanced and metastatic cancers, but patient responses vary and can change over time, complicating treatment prediction. Therefore, better tools for patient stratification, response prediction, and response assessment are needed. This study presents the development and clinical translation of a fluorescently labelled ICI tracer pair used to perform multispectral fluorescent molecular imaging and simultaneously gain spatial and temporal insight in both programmed death ligand 1 (PD-L1) and programmed death receptor 1 (PD-1) expression.

pmc-12719506.title: Moxibustion combined with chemotherapy inhibits gastric cancer growth by modulating the immunosuppressive microenvironment involving the Treg/IL-10/TGF-β1 axis
pmc-12719506.creator: Yong Wu, Li Ma, Mengying Mao, Yuling Leng, Xianyang Zhou, Heng Xu, Yanqi Ding, Wanrong Hao, Wanhui Dong, Yonglei Zeng
pmc-12719506.description: BackgroundThe immunosuppressive microenvironment poses a major challenge in gastric cancer (GC) therapy. Moxibustion, based on the “Guben Peiyuan” theory, shows potential in oncology, but its immunomodulatory mechanisms in GC remain elusive.MethodsThis study integrated bioinformatics analysis with animal experiments. We analyzed pan-cancer expression and prognostic value of IL-10 and TGF-β1 via TCGA/GTEx databases.

pmc-12873341.title: Expert-Annotated Optical Microscopy Images of Human Sperm for Detection and DNA Fragmentation Assessment
pmc-12873341.creator: Hanan Saadat, Mahdi-Reza Borna, Hossein Torkashvand
pmc-12873341.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). We present a collection of expert-labeled image datasets designed to support automated analysis of human sperm in the context of male fertility diagnostics. The collection includes three datasets: a raw set of over 400 high-resolution, stained bright-field images containing multiple sperm cells; a binary classification set with cropped image patches labeled as either sperm or non-sperm; and a multiclass dataset of individual sperm cells categorized by DNA fragmentation level, based on halo size (large, medium, small, or no halo).

pmc-13358607.title: Screening for insulin resistance in children with abdominal obesity: sex-specific performance of TyG index, FGIR, and VAI
pmc-13358607.creator: Youngyun Jin, Donghyun Kim
pmc-13358607.description: [Purpose]This study aimed to compare the diagnostic performance of the triglyceride-glucose index (TyG), fasting glucose-to-insulin ratio (FGIR), and visceral adiposity index (VAI) for detecting insulin resistance (IR) and to establish sex-specific IR cutoffs in Korean schoolchildren with abdominal obesity.[Methods]This cross-sectional study included 728 fourth- to sixth-grade students (398 boys and 330 girls; mean age, 11.5 ± 1.

pmc-13613854.title: PTGIS inhibited osteogenic and promoted angiogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells via endoplasmic reticulum stress mediated PI3K/AKT signaling
pmc-13613854.creator: Han Bao, Jiaohong Wang, Haoqing Yang, Huina Liu, Xiao Han, Zhipeng Fan
pmc-13613854.description: BackgroundMesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) play a key role in ectopic mineralization. Effective treatment requires both inhibiting pathological calcification and promoting vessel growth. While prostacyclin synthase (PTGIS) is critical for vascular health, its role in regulating osteogenic and angiogenic differentiation in MSCs remains unclear.

uslaw-cfr-t20-s404-725.title: 20 C.F.R. § 404.725 — Evidence of a valid ceremonial marriage.
uslaw-cfr-t20-s404-725.creator: Social Security Administration
uslaw-cfr-t20-s404-725.description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 20 (Employees' Benefits), Part 404 (Federal Old-Age, Survivors And Disability Insurance (1950- )). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). (a) General. A valid ceremonial marriage is one that follows procedures set by law in the State or foreign country where it takes place. These procedures cover who may perform the marriage ceremony, what licenses or witnesses.

In all proceedings brought by the United States in any court for due recovery as well of duties upon imports alone as of penalties for the nonpayment thereof, the judgment shall recite that the same is rendered for duties, and such judgment, interest.
